P.P1_bottleneck_analysis: Skill verification (if implemented). Skill matching queries.
P.P2_defensibility: Self-reported with liability disclaimer. Verification levels transparent (user knows if self-reported vs verified).
P4_failure_modes: False skill claim → person not actually trained (mitigate: disclaimer, liability waiver, matching shows verification level)
P.P5_backup_plan: Show verification level clearly. Match with high-confidence skills first.
P.P6_backup_plan_test: Test verification level display. Test matching preference for verified skills.
P.P7_testing_strategy: Unit tests for skill CRUD. Integration tests for matching with verification filters.
P.P8_benchmarks: Skill entry: <200ms. Skill matching: <1s for 50 nearby users with matching skills.

L.L1_legal_considerations: Self-reported skills create liability if person lacks actual skill. Mitigation: clear liability waiver, verification levels, matching shows disclaimer.
L2_regulatory_frameworks: Professional licensing (EMS, nurses, etc have real licenses)
L.L3_consent_requirements: User accepts liability waiver when adding skill.
L.L4_liability_notes: User responsible for accuracy of skills. Beacon not liable for injuries from unskilled person. Verified skills (with credentials) lower liability.

F.F1_cost_considerations: Skills storage: negligible. Credential verification (future): cost TBD.
F.F3_revenue_impact: Skills sharing increases community resilience (retention driver).

S.S2_data_privacy: Skill list visible to matched users only.
S.S4_access_control: User controls own skill list. Matched users see skills during help matching.

X.X1_notes: Skills registry enables mutual aid with expertise. MVP: self-reported, verification level shown. Future: credential verification, liability insurance.
X2_open_questions: Credential verification: require document upload? (future enhancement, liability reduction)
Liability cap: Beacon waives liability if user self-reported? (legal review needed)
X.X3_related_research: Professional credential verification. Mutual aid networks. Liability in volunteer-run services. Skills-based matching algorithms.
